geometry.role: Independent K/Dqk and V/Dv, fixed original arena backing/permission slots; no second arena/controller.
geometry.row_unit: one KV head of one token; per-token bytes multiply kv_heads

cpu.encoder: O(new supplied elements), original workers; Q8 F32[32] stack128 bytes/worker, finite+amax pass then original from_float_ref for nonzero stored scales; FP8 original scalar SIMD conversion. No full-history cast/encode.
cpu.metadata: One nullable encoding-state pointer per ordinary invocation; only encoder/Q8 programs cold allocate original-allocator state and O(encoder calls + Q8 readers) vectors. Error flag belongs to invocation and retires after original workers.
cpu.attention: Original generic quantized Q conversion and per-V-row decode are real arithmetic/scratch costs; no full-history KV materialization. Boxed new quant/window/Dv domain does not allocate Q*KV mask. Original plain coupled unbounded mask path remains borrowed.
cpu.plan: Per-request native plan/metadata/workspace accounting preserved; generation changes may prepare again, not claimed zero-cost decode planning.
cpu.query_validation: Each Q8 attention first scans all query values for finite/range in O(Q*Hq*Dqk), before F32 cast and original Q8 vec-dot conversion. Original DLL peer has no this safety scan; cost remains charged, no equal-instruction claim.

cuda.encoder: One dirty-only FP8 elementwise kernel plus original invocation numeric-status mechanism; no CPU math fallback.
cuda.fp8_output_staging: align16(4*query_rows*query_heads*Dv) bytes before original plan scratch. One scale_cast kernel reads F32 and writes chosen output dtype; Vscale applied after F32 split merge. This extra dispatch and staging are part of performance contract.
cuda.short_k_64_128: Only finite FP8 short-K tile padded in shared memory: +64*CTA_TILE_KV bytes of K shared allocation, zero-fill and adapted repack/smem accounting. Global K row stays64, logical dot stays64.
cuda.planning: Original PrefillPlanWorkspaceSize and PrefillPlan, integer staging/H2D and accepted prefix failure are charged; no claim of allocation-free changing-layout planning.
cuda.status_completion: Shared sequence status: first use resets4B, finish_sequence_impl copies4B back and records native event; multiple encoders share once-per-sequence status, not multiplied per encoder. Provider copy_bytes=0 is not whole-pipeline zero-copy/sync.

apple.encoder: MLX graph of cast/reduction/rounding/packing/status operations on new rows only. F32 temporaries O(new supplied elements); actual fusion/kernel count and native pool peak remain unmeasured, never asserted to be one fused kernel or zero allocation.
apple.attention: Truthful Q8 U8 root; reshape/transpose aliases; selected rows decoded in original-derived private native attention tiles. Per-request results and final concat cost O(query_rows*query_heads*Dv), no full-history K/V decode.
apple.lifetime: CE10 adds nullable retain/release branches; CE11 adds existing allocator mutex acquisition for each external statistics getter. Internal allocation/free already-locked reads direct fields; no new lock object/state or whole-execution lock.
apple.planning: Tracing/native program preparation may occur for each changed layout generation; explicitly not a G06 low-cost planning certificate.
apple.completion: Warm evaluate synchronizes original stream, waits outputs and reads status; cold prepare separately performs isolated warmup synchronizations. These remain charged at their actual warm/cold boundaries.

vulkan.encoder: Checked dirty input uses4*Ndirty safe F32 scratch plus checked dispatch, then original Q8 Copy; retirement/status read plus non-coherent flush/invalidate belong to real completion. O(newrows), not a single-dispatch/zero-scratch claim.
vulkan.attention: Original-derived Q8 direct shader decodes at use, excludes original full-history F16 expansion in admitted direct path. Actual dispatch/reduction scratch and native descriptor/pool costs still belong to native implementation.
vulkan.metadata: Existing per-request Plan/Program/controller path; views/reshape and output concatenation are charged, no duplicate runtime.

cross_route: Original F1/F2 tickets, typed ready/pending pages, original Graph encoders and native controller reused.
Dirty caller storage and returned completion are real; no blanket free-memory/capture/performance symmetry claim.
NativePagedBatchCosts.native_private_bytes_unknown remains explicit true. Host sanitizer does not bound native private pools; G10 remains pending.
P0 source structure is not qualified P1 or end-to-end token/s. Peer adapters and finite benchmark contract/oracles still required.

layout_probe.note: Source layout and existing descriptor-layout probe; no new timing or ABI-stability claim.
